terms.gloss: necessity, compulsion, what cannot be avoided
evidence: Cic. Fam. 4.9.2: temporī cēdere, id est necessitātī pārēre, semper sapientis est habitum (Lewis & Short)
Cic. Off. 2.56: veniam necessitātī dare (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: temporī cēdere, id est necessitātī pārēre, semper sapientis est habitum
phrases.english: to yield to the moment, that is to obey necessity, has always been thought the part of a wise man
